snippet.title: Planet Zoo: Americas Animal Pack | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The Planet Zoo: Americas Animal Pack is available now on PC! Seven new species, 80+ incredible new scenery pieces AND an exciting new campaign scenario. Buy Now: https://fron.dev/PZ19A-YT

This exclusive collection will bring you closer to a host of new species, including the sleek and elusive Ocelot, the highly intelligent Coyote, and the small and social Bush Dog. 

Alongside these stunning additions, the Americas Animal Pack also features over 80 eye-catching scenery pieces alongside a brand-new campaign scenario, where you will help Dominic Myers in his adventure to set up a successful zoo in Mexico.  

For more news and information about Planet Zoo 👇
